description: Search videos you may reuse commercially with credit: Wikimedia Commons video files (WebM, Ogg) and Internet Archive videos whose uploader set CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0 or the Public Domain Mark. Each media row (type video) has the title, creator, duration_s, a thumbnail, the page or file link, its licence and its own credit line; items with no licence or an NC or ND one are left out. Costs 1 credit per source searched, at most 2. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

q.description: What the video shows, such as "volcano eruption".

name: data_search_videos
title: Search openly licensed videos
